title: Bahmani Military
definition: The Bahmani military was a centralized, multi-ethnic, and gunpowder-reliant force that evolved from a feudal-cavalry structure into a sophisticated administrative-military apparatus, serving as the primary instrument for the Sultanate's expansion and defense against the Vijayanagara Empire.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the evolution of medieval Indian warfare, the introduction of gunpowder, and the socio-political tensions between 'Afaqis' (foreigners) and 'Dakhinis' (locals) within the military hierarchy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bahmani Military.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Delhi Sultanate military administration
